racials.name: Ruthless
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2%.

racials.name: The Human Spirit
racials.desc: Spirit increased by 5%.

racials.name: Perception
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

racials.name: Will to Survive
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.

priest.name: Divine Grace
priest.desc: 40 yd range, Instant, 10 min cooldown. Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1,285 to 1,513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

priest.name: Feedback
priest.desc: 230 Mana, Instant, 3 min cooldown. The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy.  Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned.  Lasts 15 sec.

racials.name: Find Treasure
racials.desc: Instant. Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

racials.name: Stoneform
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

racials.name: Earth Fury
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

racials.name: Big Game Hunter
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

priest.name: Chastise
priest.desc: 225 Mana, 20 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown. Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.

priest.name: Desperate Prayer
priest.desc: Instant, 10 min cooldown. Instantly heals the caster for 1,285 to 1,513.

racials.name: Shadowmeld
racials.desc: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

racials.name: Quickness
racials.desc: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

racials.name: Wisp Spirit
racials.desc: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

racials.name: Elune's Light
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

priest.name: Elune's Grace
priest.desc: 3% of base mana, Instant, 5 min cooldown. Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

priest.name: Starshards
priest.desc: 350 Mana, 30 yd range, Channeled, 30 sec cooldown. Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1,800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

racials.name: Escape Artist
racials.desc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

racials.name: Expansive Mind
racials.desc: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%, whichever your class uses.

racials.name: Engineering Specialization
racials.desc: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

racials.name: Eureka!
racials.desc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

priest.name: Confounding Flash
priest.desc: 3% of base mana, 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

priest.name: Contingency Plan
priest.desc: 30 yd range, Instant, 10 min cooldown. Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

racials.name: Walk on Air
racials.desc: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

racials.name: Read Leyline
racials.desc: 2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 30 sec if no leyline is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

racials.name: Elemental Insight
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

racials.name: Wind Blessed
racials.desc: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.

racials.name: Blood Fury
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

racials.name: Hardiness
racials.desc: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

racials.name: Savage
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1%.

racials.name: Shatter Curse
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

racials.name: Underwater Breathing
racials.desc: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

racials.name: Will of the Forsaken
racials.desc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

racials.name: Cannibalize
racials.desc: 5 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown. When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

racials.name: Touch of the Grave
racials.desc: Your spells and attacks with a damage part have a chance (30% for casters, 20% for Paladins, Rogues and Warriors) to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. 25 sec internal cooldown. Does not break crowd control.

priest.name: Dark Sacrifice
priest.desc: Instant, 10 min cooldown. Cannibalize 1,600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1,600 Mana, plus your Spirit.

priest.name: Touch of Weakness
priest.desc: 195 Mana, Instant. The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.

racials.name: War Stomp
racials.desc: 0.5 sec cast, 1.5 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

racials.name: Endurance
racials.desc: Total Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

racials.name: Cultivation
racials.desc: Instant. Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

racials.name: Plainsrunning
racials.desc: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. In addition, you move 3% faster while mounted.

racials.name: Berserking
racials.desc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

racials.name: Regeneration
racials.desc: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

racials.name: Beast Slaying
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

racials.name: Rapid Regeneration
racials.desc: Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

priest.name: Hex of Weakness
priest.desc: 240 Mana, 30 yd range, Instant. Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min

priest.name: Shadowguard
priest.desc: 250 Mana, Instant. The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.

racials.name: Walk on Air
racials.desc: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

racials.name: Skysight
racials.desc: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

racials.name: Elemental Insight
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

racials.name: Wind Blessed
racials.desc: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.
